name: caves of chaos adventurer
mana cost: {3}{R}
types: creature human barbarian
power toughness: 5/3
static: trample
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, you take the initiative.
triggered: whenever CARDNAME attacks, exile the top card of your library. if you've completed a dungeon, you may play that card this turn without paying its mana cost. otherwise, you may play that card this turn.
